title: Chapter 186: Aftermath
content:
Chapter 186: Aftermath

"God is really helping me!" Wang Shuo couldn't help laughing!

When Wang Shuo was watching the animation just now, he noticed that the plaque on the Lord's Mansion said "Dragon King Heavenly Palace". It must have been buried underground and changed to "Dragon King Underground Palace" by Lord Zach!

With the map, Wang Shuo instantly had the confidence to explore the underground palace.

But Wang Shuo was not hot-headed and took action immediately. The matter was serious and required long-term planning.

At this time, something has obviously changed in the Dragon King's underground palace. If you want to find out, you must be fully prepared.

Wang Shuo took out the three tips left for him by Lord Zach and found that there was still no movement.

After thinking for a while, Wang Shuo came to the backyard.

There was another drop of water of life on the rockery, and Wang Shuo collected it again with a delicate vial.

Seeing two koi fish swimming around, Wang Shuo took out another energy crystal and fed it to them.

This time, a koi actually bit off half of it in one bite.

Wang Shuo took a closer look and found that it had actually grown a bit, already half the length of chopsticks.

No wonder the appetite has increased.

The surrounding flowers, plants and trees also came to life and looked full of vitality.

At this time, Wang Shuo discovered a piece of dog poop in the backyard, which looked quite fresh.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but laugh.

I haven’t seen this silly dog for a long time.

"Rhubarb!" Wang Shuo shouted.

After a while, there was no movement.

Wang Shuo thought to himself, this guy is totally out of tune.

Just as he was about to leave the backyard, Dahuang swaggered up to Wang Shuo.

After a few days, Dahuang has grown in size, and his fur has become smoother and softer.

Seeing the energy crystal in Wang Shuo's hand, it barked "woof".

"You want to eat this too?" Wang Shuo stared at it in confusion, thought for a moment, and threw the energy crystal in his hand to Dahuang.

Dahuang quickly jumped forward, caught the energy crystal with his mouth, and started chewing it.

Just when Wang Shuo was feeding the fish and amusing the dogs, he was at the ruins of Fengze Village.

Zhao Tianze is back!

Seeing the ruins in front of him, his eyes were filled with anger.

His mother died when he was very young and he grew up with an alcoholic father.

Every time Dad gets drunk, he is likely to be punched and kicked.

Every time he was beaten, he silently remembered it in his heart, until one day, he finally fought back and accidentally beat his father to death.

Terrified, he immediately left home.

While wandering, he joined a gangster organization and became a small gangster.

This experience also made him understand a truth.

If you can't fight, fight, if you can't, then give in. A gentleman takes revenge, and it's never too late in ten years.

At this time, he felt hatred towards Wang Shuo.

His chest heaved violently, his face was red, and his eyes were about to burst into flames.

After a while, he gritted his teeth and roared: "Wang Shuo, I am at odds with you today. If I don't make your life worse than death, I will be a useless person."

Wang Shuo naturally couldn't hear his angry shouts.

In the meeting hall, Wang Shuo summoned the core personnel of the territory.

Discuss how to deal with the crisis in the territory.

"If you all have any opinions, tell us and brainstorm!" Wang Shuo looked around and asked.

At this time, Wana Village was full of talents, and Wang Shuo understood the principle that listening to both sides would lead to enlightenment, while listening to one side would lead to darkness.

"Lord, I think we should dig up the surface of the earth and enter the underground palace to find out."

Ayub's eyes were cold and his face was resolute.

Zou Yuanjie shook his feather fan, frowned and said, "Lord, this black aura looks like the legendary 'death aura'. If living beings come into contact with it for a long time, there is a risk of being infected and transformed into undead."

"Dead anger?"

"I have read in an ancient book before that in a place infected with death energy, all living things are forbidden. If the area is contaminated with death energy for a long time, the living beings will turn into undead."

Wang Shuo thought for a while, could it be that all the undead that attacked Black Dragon City were infected by this death energy?

If so, that's not good.
